source.body: {"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"batch","sql":"SELECT batch_id, recipe, phase FROM mes_batch_run WHERE batch_path = ?","params":["${input.batchPath}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"batch","message":"Batch not found"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","batchPath":"${input.batchPath}","batchId":"${batch.batch_id}","recipe":"${batch.recipe}","phase":"${batch.phase}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_batch_run SET phase = ?, batch_id = ?, recipe = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), recipe), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE batch_path = ?","params":["${input.phase}","${input.batchId}","${input.recipe}","${input.batchPath}"]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"updated","sql":"SELECT batch_path FROM mes_batch_run WHERE batch_path = ?","params":["${input.batchPath}"]},{"type":"when","var":"updated","notNull":false,"then":[{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO mes_batch_run (batch_path, batch_id, recipe, phase) VALUES (?, ?, COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), 'default-recipe'), ?)","params":["${input.batchPath}","${input.batchId}","${input.recipe}","${input.phase}"]}]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","batchPath":"${input.batchPath}","phase":"${input.phase}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"flat","sql":"SELECT h.bom_id, h.parent_material_code, h.revision, l.line_no, l.component_material_code, COALESCE(m.display_name, '') AS component_name, l.quantity, l.uom, 1 AS level_no, CONCAT(h.parent_material_code, '>', l.component_material_code) AS path FROM mes_bom_header h JOIN mes_bom_line l ON l.bom_id = h.bom_id LEFT JOIN mes_genealogy_material m ON m.material_code = l.component_material_code WHERE h.parent_material_code = ? AND h.status = 'active' ORDER BY l.line_no","params":["${input.materialCode}"]},{"type":"selectMany","var":"nested","sql":"SELECT h.bom_id, h.parent_material_code, h.revision, l.line_no, l.component_material_code, COALESCE(m.display_name, '') AS component_name, l.quantity, l.uom, 1 AS level_no, CONCAT(h.parent_material_code, '>', l.component_material_code) AS path FROM mes_bom_header h JOIN mes_bom_line l ON l.bom_id = h.bom_id LEFT JOIN mes_genealogy_material m ON m.material_code = l.component_material_code WHERE h.parent_material_code = ? AND h.status = 'active' ORDER BY l.line_no","params":["${input.materialCode}"]},{"type":"map","var":"flatRows","source":"${flat}","fields":{"bomId":"${item.bom_id}","parentMaterialCode":"${item.parent_material_code}","revision":"${item.revision}","lineNo":"${item.line_no}","componentMaterialCode":"${item.component_material_code}","componentName":"${item.component_name}","quantity":"${item.quantity}","uom":"${item.uom}","level":"${item.level_no}","path":"${item.path}"}},{"type":"map","var":"nestedRows","source":"${nested}","fields":{"bomId":"${item.bom_id}","parentMaterialCode":"${item.parent_material_code}","revision":"${item.revision}","lineNo":"${item.line_no}","componentMaterialCode":"${item.component_material_code}","componentName":"${item.component_name}","quantity":"${item.quantity}","uom":"${item.uom}","level":"${item.level_no}","path":"${item.path}"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","materialCode":"${input.materialCode}","rows":"${flatRows}","nestedRows":"${nestedRows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"parents","sql":"SELECT h.bom_id, h.parent_material_code, COALESCE(m.display_name, '') AS parent_name, h.revision, l.line_no, l.quantity, l.uom, h.status FROM mes_bom_header h JOIN mes_bom_line l ON l.bom_id = h.bom_id LEFT JOIN mes_genealogy_material m ON m.material_code = h.parent_material_code WHERE l.component_material_code = ? ORDER BY h.parent_material_code, h.revision, l.line_no","params":["${input.componentMaterialCode}"]},{"type":"map","var":"rows","source":"${parents}","fields":{"bomId":"${item.bom_id}","parentMaterialCode":"${item.parent_material_code}","parentName":"${item.parent_name}","revision":"${item.revision}","lineNo":"${item.line_no}","quantity":"${item.quantity}","uom":"${item.uom}","status":"${item.status}"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","componentMaterialCode":"${input.componentMaterialCode}","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"writeVariable","objectPath":"root.platform.mes.work-orders.wo-line-a01-001","variable":"status","fields":{"value":"complete"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","confirmed":true,"workOrderPath":"${input.workOrderPath}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO mes_erp_outbox (id, entity_type, entity_id, payload_json, idempotency_key, status) SELECT RANDOM_UUID(), ?, ?, ?, CONCAT(?, ':', ?), 'pending' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_erp_outbox WHERE idempotency_key = CONCAT(?, ':', ?))","params":["${input.entityType}","${input.entityId}","${input.payloadJson}","${input.entityType}","${input.entityId}","${input.entityType}","${input.entityId}"]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"keyRow","sql":"SELECT CONCAT(?, ':', ?) AS idempotency_key","params":["${input.entityType}","${input.entityId}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","enqueued":true,"idempotencyKey":"${keyRow.idempotency_key}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"pending","sql":"UPDATE mes_erp_outbox SET status = 'simulated', processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'pending'"},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_erp_outbox SET status = 'simulated', processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'pending'"},{"type":"map","var":"rows","source":"${pending}","fields":{"outboxId":"${item.outbox_id}","entityType":"${item.entity_type}","entityId":"${item.entity_id}","idempotencyKey":"${item.idempotency_key}","status":"simulated"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"edges","sql":"SELECT i.entity_id AS from_entity_id, COALESCE(src.lot_id, '') AS from_lot_id, COALESCE(src.material_code, '') AS from_material_code, o.entity_id AS to_entity_id, COALESCE(dst.lot_id, '') AS to_lot_id, COALESCE(dst.material_code, '') AS to_material_code, a.activity_id, a.activity_type, o.quantity AS quantity, a.work_order_number, a.line_code, CAST(a.occurred_at AS VARCHAR) AS occurred_at FROM mes_tracked_activity a JOIN mes_tracked_activity_input i ON i.activity_id = a.activity_id JOIN mes_tracked_activity_output o ON o.activity_id = a.activity_id JOIN mes_tracked_entity src ON src.entity_id = i.entity_id JOIN mes_tracked_entity dst ON dst.entity_id = o.entity_id ORDER BY a.activity_id, i.entity_id, o.entity_id"},{"type":"map","var":"rows","source":"${edges}","fields":{"fromEntityId":"${item.from_entity_id}","fromLotId":"${item.from_lot_id}","fromMaterialCode":"${item.from_material_code}","toEntityId":"${item.to_entity_id}","toLotId":"${item.to_lot_id}","toMaterialCode":"${item.to_material_code}","activityId":"${item.activity_id}","activityType":"${item.activity_type}","quantity":"${item.quantity}","workOrderNumber":"${item.work_order_number}","lineCode":"${item.line_code}","occurredAt":"${item.occurred_at}"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"links","sql":"SELECT l.lot_id, l.lot_path, l.material_code, m.display_name AS material_name, l.work_order_number, l.line_code, l.quantity, l.status AS lot_status, q.quality_id, COALESCE(q.defect_code, '') AS defect_code, COALESCE(q.severity, '') AS severity, COALESCE(q.result, '') AS quality_result, COALESCE(q.recorded_at::text, '') AS recorded_at FROM mes_genealogy_lot l JOIN mes_genealogy_material m ON m.material_code = l.material_code LEFT JOIN mes_genealogy_quality q ON q.lot_id = l.lot_id ORDER BY l.lot_id, q.recorded_at"},{"type":"map","var":"rows","source":"${links}","fields":{"lotId":"${item.lot_id}","lotPath":"${item.lot_path}","materialCode":"${item.material_code}","materialName":"${item.material_name}","workOrderNumber":"${item.work_order_number}","lineCode":"${item.line_code}","quantity":"${item.quantity}","lotStatus":"${item.lot_status}","qualityId":"${item.quality_id}","defectCode":"${item.defect_code}","severity":"${item.severity}","qualityResult":"${item.quality_result}","recordedAt":"${item.recorded_at}"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"links","sql":"SELECT l.lot_id, l.lot_path, l.material_code, m.display_name AS material_name, l.work_order_number, l.line_code, l.quantity, l.status AS lot_status, q.quality_id, COALESCE(q.defect_code, '') AS defect_code, COALESCE(q.severity, '') AS severity, COALESCE(q.result, '') AS quality_result, COALESCE(q.recorded_at::text, '') AS recorded_at FROM mes_genealogy_lot l JOIN mes_genealogy_material m ON m.material_code = l.material_code LEFT JOIN mes_genealogy_quality q ON q.lot_id = l.lot_id WHERE l.lot_id = ? ORDER BY q.recorded_at","params":["${input.lotId}"]},{"type":"map","var":"rows","source":"${links}","fields":{"lotId":"${item.lot_id}","lotPath":"${item.lot_path}","materialCode":"${item.material_code}","materialName":"${item.material_name}","workOrderNumber":"${item.work_order_number}","lineCode":"${item.line_code}","quantity":"${item.quantity}","lotStatus":"${item.lot_status}","qualityId":"${item.quality_id}","defectCode":"${item.defect_code}","severity":"${item.severity}","qualityResult":"${item.quality_result}","recordedAt":"${item.recorded_at}"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","lotId":"${input.lotId}","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"edges","sql":"SELECT i.entity_id AS from_entity_id, COALESCE(src.lot_id, '') AS from_lot_id, COALESCE(src.material_code, '') AS from_material_code, o.entity_id AS to_entity_id, COALESCE(dst.lot_id, '') AS to_lot_id, COALESCE(dst.material_code, '') AS to_material_code, a.activity_id, a.activity_type, o.quantity AS quantity, a.work_order_number, a.line_code, CAST(a.occurred_at AS VARCHAR) AS occurred_at FROM mes_tracked_activity a JOIN mes_tracked_activity_input i ON i.activity_id = a.activity_id JOIN mes_tracked_activity_output o ON o.activity_id = a.activity_id JOIN mes_tracked_entity src ON src.entity_id = i.entity_id JOIN mes_tracked_entity dst ON dst.entity_id = o.entity_id WHERE src.lot_id = ? OR dst.lot_id = ? OR src.entity_id = ? OR dst.entity_id = ? ORDER BY a.activity_id, i.entity_id, o.entity_id","params":["${input.lotId}","${input.lotId}","${input.lotId}","${input.lotId}"]},{"type":"map","var":"rows","source":"${edges}","fields":{"fromEntityId":"${item.from_entity_id}","fromLotId":"${item.from_lot_id}","fromMaterialCode":"${item.from_material_code}","toEntityId":"${item.to_entity_id}","toLotId":"${item.to_lot_id}","toMaterialCode":"${item.to_material_code}","activityId":"${item.activity_id}","activityType":"${item.activity_type}","quantity":"${item.quantity}","workOrderNumber":"${item.work_order_number}","lineCode":"${item.line_code}","occurredAt":"${item.occurred_at}"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","lotId":"${input.lotId}","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"shift","sql":"UPDATE mes_oee_shift SET downtime_minutes = LEAST(planned_minutes, downtime_minutes + ?) WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)","params":["${input.shiftId}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"shift","message":"Shift not found"},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_oee_shift SET downtime_minutes = LEAST(planned_minutes, downtime_minutes + ?) WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)","params":["${input.minutes}","${input.shiftId}"]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"updated","sql":"SELECT downtime_minutes FROM mes_oee_shift WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)","params":["${input.shiftId}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","downtimeMinutes":"${updated.downtime_minutes}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"kpi","sql":"SELECT line_code, shift_label, CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN planned_minutes > 0 THEN (planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) * 100.0 / planned_minutes ELSE 0 END, 0) AS INT) AS availability_pct, CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN (planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) > 0 AND total_units > 0 THEN LEAST(100.0, ideal_cycle_sec * total_units * 100.0 / ((planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) * 60)) ELSE 0 END, 0) AS INT) AS performance_pct, CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN total_units > 0 THEN good_units * 100.0 / total_units ELSE 0 END, 0) AS INT) AS quality_pct, CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN planned_minutes > 0 AND total_units > 0 THEN (CASE WHEN planned_minutes > 0 THEN (planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) * 1.0 / planned_minutes ELSE 0 END) * (CASE WHEN (planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) > 0 AND total_units > 0 THEN LEAST(1.0, ideal_cycle_sec * total_units * 1.0 / ((planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) * 60)) ELSE 0 END) * (CASE WHEN total_units > 0 THEN good_units * 1.0 / total_units ELSE 0 END) * 100 ELSE 0 END, 0) AS INT) AS oee_pct FROM mes_oee_shift WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)","params":["${input.shiftId}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"kpi","message":"Shift not found"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","lineCode":"${kpi.line_code}","shiftLabel":"${kpi.shift_label}","availabilityPct":"${kpi.availability_pct}","performancePct":"${kpi.performance_pct}","qualityPct":"${kpi.quality_pct}","oeePct":"${kpi.oee_pct}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"shifts","sql":"SELECT id::text AS shift_id, line_code, shift_label, planned_minutes, downtime_minutes, total_units, good_units FROM mes_oee_shift ORDER BY line_code, shift_label"},{"type":"map","var":"rows","source":"${shifts}","fields":{"shiftId":"${item.shift_id}","lineCode":"${item.line_code}","shiftLabel":"${item.shift_label}","plannedMinutes":"${item.planned_minutes}","downtimeMinutes":"${item.downtime_minutes}","totalUnits":"${item.total_units}","goodUnits":"${item.good_units}"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"operation","sql":"SELECT s.wo_number, d.operation_id, d.routing_id, d.name, d.work_center, d.sequence_no, s.status FROM mes_operation_status s JOIN mes_operation_def d ON d.operation_id = s.operation_id WHERE s.wo_number = ? AND s.status = 'ready' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_operation_edge e LEFT JOIN mes_operation_status ps ON ps.wo_number = s.wo_number AND ps.operation_id = e.predecessor_op WHERE e.routing_id = d.routing_id AND e.successor_op = s.operation_id AND (ps.status IS NULL OR ps.status <> 'complete')) ORDER BY d.sequence_no","params":["${input.workOrderNumber}","${input.operationId}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"operation","message":"Operation status not found"},{"type":"exec","sql":"SELECT s.wo_number, d.operation_id, d.routing_id, d.name, d.work_center, d.sequence_no, s.status FROM mes_operation_status s JOIN mes_operation_def d ON d.operation_id = s.operation_id WHERE s.wo_number = ? AND s.status = 'ready' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_operation_edge e LEFT JOIN mes_operation_status ps ON ps.wo_number = s.wo_number AND ps.operation_id = e.predecessor_op WHERE e.routing_id = d.routing_id AND e.successor_op = s.operation_id AND (ps.status IS NULL OR ps.status <> 'complete')) ORDER BY d.sequence_no","params":["${input.workOrderNumber}","${input.operationId}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"SELECT s.wo_number, d.operation_id, d.routing_id, d.name, d.work_center, d.sequence_no, s.status FROM mes_operation_status s JOIN mes_operation_def d ON d.operation_id = s.operation_id WHERE s.wo_number = ? migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_platform_line (line_code VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY, display_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, area_path VARCHAR(256)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_oee_shift (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, line_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, shift_label VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, planned_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, downtime_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, ideal_cycle_sec INTEGER NOT NULL, total_units INTEGER NOT NULL, good_units INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_spc_sample (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, line_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, measurement_mm NUMERIC(8,3) NOT NULL, sample_ts TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_erp_outbox (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, entity_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, entity_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, processed_at TIMESTAMP NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_batch_run (batch_path VARCHAR(256) PRIMARY KEY, batch_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, recipe VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, phase VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle', updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_genealogy_material (material_code VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, display_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, uom VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EA'); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_genealogy_lot (lot_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, lot_path VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, material_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, work_order_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, line_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, quantity NUMERIC(12,3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_genealogy_quality (quality_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, lot_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, defect_code VARCHAR(64), severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ok', result VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pass', recorded_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_tracked_entity (entity_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, entity_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, lot_id VARCHAR(64), material_code VARCHAR(64), status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available', attributes_json TEXT DEFAULT '{}'); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_tracked_activity (activity_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, activity_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, work_order_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, line_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, occurred_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, attributes_json TEXT DEFAULT '{}'); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_tracked_activity_input (activity_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, entity_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, quantity NUMERIC(12,3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (activity_id, entity_id)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_tracked_activity_output (activity_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, entity_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, quantity NUMERIC(12,3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (activity_id, entity_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_bom_header (bom_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, parent_material_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, revision VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_bom_line (bom_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, line_no INTEGER NOT NULL, component_material_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, quantity NUMERIC(12,3) NOT NULL, uom VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (bom_id, line_no)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_operation_def (operation_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, routing_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, work_center VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, sequence_no INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_operation_edge (routing_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, predecessor_op VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, successor_op VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (routing_id, predecessor_op, successor_op)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_operation_status (wo_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, operation_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'ready', 'complete')), PRIMARY KEY (wo_number, operation_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_recipe (recipe_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, effective_from TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, effective_to TIMESTAMP, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (recipe_id, revision));
ALTER TABLE mes_batch_run ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS hold_reason VARCHAR(256);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS mes_tracked_activity_input_entity_idx ON mes_tracked_activity_input (entity_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS mes_tracked_activity_output_entity_idx ON mes_tracked_activity_output (entity_id);

reports.query: SELECT i.entity_id AS from_entity_id, COALESCE(src.lot_id, '') AS from_lot_id, COALESCE(src.material_code, '') AS from_material_code, o.entity_id AS to_entity_id, COALESCE(dst.lot_id, '') AS to_lot_id, COALESCE(dst.material_code, '') AS to_material_code, a.activity_id, a.activity_type, o.quantity AS quantity, a.work_order_number, a.line_code, CAST(a.occurred_at AS VARCHAR) AS occurred_at FROM mes_tracked_activity a JOIN mes_tracked_activity_input i ON i.activity_id = a.activity_id JOIN mes_tracked_activity_output o ON o.activity_id = a.activity_id JOIN mes_tracked_entity src ON src.entity_id = i.entity_id JOIN mes_tracked_entity dst ON dst.entity_id = o.entity_id ORDER BY a.activity_id, i.entity_id, o.entity_id
